content: {"action":"upsert_decision_section","body":"Route-blue service at TRN-065 v8 reports 88.3 percent availability as current [TRANSIT]. Paratransit service at TRN-066 v8 reports 90.0 percent availability as current [TRANSIT]. These are distinct accessibility gates: route-blue covers standard accessible routes, while paratransit serves mobility-restricted populations; neither may be substituted for the other in coverage planning [TRANSIT]. The REVIEW source records REV-071 at v8 with 11.8 open-findings (accessibility) as current [REVIEW], indicating that accessible-vehicle confirmation remains an unresolved blocking finding [REVIEW]. Falsifier: if either route-blue or paratransit availability falls below 85 percent on re-observation, the corresponding accessibility gate is invalid and continuity staging must be revised [TRANSIT][REVIEW]. Rollback: reverting to pre-surge transit allocation requires current-status confirmation that both services return above threshold and accessible-vehicle blocking findings are closed [TRANSIT][REVIEW]. The distinction between availability percentage and actual rider demand coverage is maintained: a high availability figure does not guarantee that all heat-affected residents can reach cooling centers within acceptable wait times [TRANSIT].","heading":"Transit, communications, logistics, and staffing"}
